title: Replace wall-clock DateTime.now() calls in step_starting_position_l1_test.dart with fixed dates
rule: TQ-6 (hermetic tests: no wall-clock; use clockProvider/fixed DateTimeFactory only)
why: Six tests in the 'StartingPositionCalendarMode — B2 date window' group read the real wall clock via DateTime.now() instead of a fixed date, even though the same file's section D ('ProgramStartingPosition.allowedWindow — B2 window contract', lines 1408-1509) already covers the identical invariants deterministically with DateTime(2026, 6, 1) literals, and the repo has a DateTimeFactory fixed-clock utility used elsewhere (e.g. drift_memory.dart, edit_track_screen.dart). Wall-clock reads in date-window-boundary logic are exactly the kind of test Nygard/TQ-6 flag as a latent flakiness risk (month/DST/leap-year boundaries), and they duplicate coverage the file's own section D already provides hermetically.
recommendation: Replace `final today = DateTime.now();` with a fixed `DateTime(...)` literal (or DateTimeFactory override) in each of the 6 sites, matching the pattern already used in section D of the same file.
acceptance_criteria: No DateTime.now() calls remain in step_starting_position_l1_test.dart
Tests still pass with a pinned/fixed date, proving the assertions don't depend on the actual current day
